== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. Compared with [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole of the 2018 E card and the whole of the disc card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>995884489598e2a3714323b1e287a57ab95c96b7</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
